methodology: Articles sourced from Virginia-specific RSS feeds and Google News RSS, filtered for AI/technology/workforce relevance, then assessed by Claude against the scenario framework. Each article is tagged with the region it most affects and the scenario it signals toward.

signals.title: New partnership between VCU and AI Ready RVA aims to boost AI education, innovation and community impact - VCU News
signals.signal_reading: VCU's partnership with AI Ready RVA represents intentional peer-network infrastructure for distributed AI fluency beyond elite institutions, potentially seeding community-level capability building rather than platform dependence.

signals.title: Compass Datacenters pulls out of Digital Gateway AI data center project - qz.com
signals.signal_reading: Compass Datacenters withdrawing from a major AI infrastructure project signals that even NoVA's concentrated AI advantage faces sustainability questions, though the underlying capability concentration remains unchallenged.

signals.title: Amid AI, Quantum Tech, Chesterfield County, Va., Invests in Cyber - govtech.com
signals.signal_reading: Chesterfield County's cybersecurity investment amid AI/quantum developments shows Richmond metro building deep complementary capabilities, but concentration in metro counties rather than distributed adoption patterns.

signals.title: RC-RV partners with ed2go to launch innovative, on-demand workforce training programs - Roanoke College
signals.signal_reading: RC-RV's partnership with ed2go for on-demand workforce training suggests platform-mediated rather than indigenous AI skill development, creating surface-level access without deep local capability building in underserved regions.

signals.title: Teaching AI by Doing, Not Studying - Inside Higher Ed
signals.signal_reading: Emphasis on experiential AI learning over theoretical study indicates pedagogy shift toward hands-on fluency development, which if scaled across Virginia institutions could enable distributed depth rather than concentrated expertise.
